companies.name: OctaPulse
companies.originalOneLiner: CV and robotics to automate quality inspection in fish farms
companies.originalDescription: OctaPulse uses AI vision to automate hatchery QA for fish farms, starting with broodstock phenotyping and juvenile deformity inspection. We cut inspection time from about 5 minutes to under 30 seconds per fish, with more than 90 percent accuracy, so farms advance only high quality fish and waste less feed and labor. Our goal is to bring automation across the entire fish production lifecycle for the $300B aquaculture industry. Aquaculture is the fastest growing food sector, and has already surpassed commercial fishing for production of seafood. Yet two of the most critical QA and QC steps in fish production are still done by hand: phenotyping and deformity inspection. These processes are slow, error prone, and despised by technicians but vital for the success of the farm, so much so that farms spend >$200K a year on trained technicians and geneticists to operate. We’ve built an AI vision platform for vertically integrated finfish farms that drops into existing workflows starting in the hatchery, uses off the shelf cameras, standardizes these QA steps, and creates a proprietary multi species dataset that becomes the brain for future autonomous aquafarms. Phenotyping is the start, but the platform is designed to be a drop in solution that can easily expand into feeding, health monitoring, and processing so we can solve production problems across the lifecycle. We signed a 6-figure paid pilot with the largest trout producer in the United States, are deploying into 2 more farms early 2026, and trained models above 90 percent accuracy while cutting inspection time from 5 minutes to under 30 seconds. Each deployment adds labeled images to our dataset and improves cross species generalization.
companies.story: OctaPulse 是一家用人工智能视觉技术为水产养殖场做质量检测的公司。想象你是一个水产养殖场的质检负责人，每天要人工检查成千上万条鱼苗，看它们有没有畸形，还要给种鱼做表型分析。传统方法每检查一条鱼要五分钟，又慢又容易出错，而且请专业技师和遗传学家一年要花二十多万美元。OctaPulse 用计算机视觉和机器人技术，把每条鱼的检查时间缩短到三十秒以内，准确率超过百分之九十。这样你就能快速筛选出优质鱼苗，减少饲料和人工浪费。这家公司来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，目前团队只有两人，但瞄准的是三千亿美元的水产养殖市场，值得关注。

companies.name: Salus
companies.originalOneLiner: Guardrails to validate your agent's actions before they execute
companies.originalDescription: Your agent processed a refund without looking up the order ID, costing you thousands. You only found out three hours later from a support ticket. Evals, output scoring, and observability can reduce the likelihood of mistakes like these occurring - but there's no solution that inspects and prevents an action as it’s about to execute. Salus does that. We’ve built an API that wraps around your agent and checks its actions at run time, blocking incorrect ones and providing immediate feedback to guide retries.
companies.story: Salus 是一家做人工智能智能体安全防护的公司。想象你是一个电商平台的后端工程师，你开发的智能体在处理退款时，没有查订单号就执行了操作，导致公司损失了几千美元，而你三小时后才从客服工单里发现。现有的评估和监控工具只能在事后发现问题，Salus 则是在智能体执行动作之前进行拦截。它通过一个接口包裹住你的智能体，在运行时检查每一个动作，阻止错误的操作，并给出即时反馈让智能体重试。这家公司来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，目前正在招聘，团队两人。对于依赖智能体处理关键业务的公司来说，这种事前防护很值得关注。

companies.name: OnDeck AI
companies.originalOneLiner: Analyze any footage, without training a model
companies.originalDescription: OnDeck is the infrastructure layer that makes Vision Language Models accessible and scalable for enterprise. Our model, Perception-0, let organizations instantly find any object, behavior or event, in any footage, without needing to train a model or collect any training data. The Pain: Creating vision models usually takes months: collecting training data, training, then deployment. Worse yet: + it’s often impossible to get enough data for a specific task, and + even the best cv models struggle to generalize across diverse camera setups, workflows and environments. To overcome these blockers, we bet early on the power of VLMs and built a vision engine that can generalize across any task and doesn’t need any training data. We published a NeurIPS workshop paper showing our new methods with VLMs beat traditional CV even at niche tasks. Now, our model Perception-0 beats the best VLMs including Gemini at long video understanding. Our current customers include: - National Defense Organizations - Robotics Research - Security cameras - Behaviour analysis for port monitoring - Off-shore oil & gas monitoring
companies.story: OnDeck AI 是一家做视觉语言模型基础设施的公司。想象你是一个工厂的安全主管，你想用摄像头自动检测工人有没有戴安全帽，但传统计算机视觉模型需要收集大量训练数据，训练好几个月，而且换个摄像头角度就失灵了。OnDeck 的模型 Perception-0 不需要任何训练数据，就能在任意视频中识别物体、行为或事件。他们发表了一篇 NeurIPS 研讨会论文，证明他们的方法在专业任务上超过了传统计算机视觉。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队七人，正在招聘。对于想快速部署视觉识别但又不想投入大量数据标注的企业来说，这个方案很有吸引力。

companies.name: Confident AI
companies.originalOneLiner: The LLM Eval and Observability Platform for AI Quality
companies.originalDescription: Confident AI provides enterprises an all-in-one platform to evaluate, observe, red team, and govern AI applications. Built by the creators of DeepEval (16k stars, 8m monthly downloads), Confident AI is able to offer battle-tested, open-source evaluation algorithms while providing the infrastructure needed for teams to stay confident their AI systems.
companies.story: Confident AI 是一家做人工智能评估和可观测性平台的公司。想象你是一个机器学习平台组的负责人，你们开发了一个大语言模型应用，但上线前不知道它会不会胡说八道，上线后又很难监控它的表现。Confident AI 提供了一个一站式平台，可以评估、观测、红队测试和治理人工智能应用。它是由开源项目 DeepEval 的开发者创建的，DeepEval 在 GitHub 上有 1.6 万星标，每月下载量八百万。这家公司来自 YC 冬季 2025 批次，团队七人，正在招聘。对于需要确保人工智能系统质量的企业团队来说，这个平台有实战验证的算法，值得关注。

companies.name: Egoist Machines
companies.originalOneLiner: Secure, user-owned context for every AI app
companies.originalDescription: The bottleneck for consumer AI is shifting from the model to the personal context that model uses. Models are already capable of completing most tasks for the average user, but consumer AI products still starts cold and have to rebuild an incomplete picture of the same user before they can personalise well. We’re building AI Passport so users can carry the personal context they create through everyday apps into new products, allowing those products to understand them from the first interaction instead of reconstructing the same incomplete picture from scratch. Users decide which parts of their context can move between products, while companies receive better information about their users. Apps integrate AI Passport through a “Sign in with AI Passport” button, then request specific information for a stated purpose and duration rather than receiving broad, permanent access to everything the Passport holds. The user chooses what to share and can revoke access later, which makes the system particularly useful for sensitive health or financial context that may be valuable for a specific interaction but should not remain available indefinitely. To support this permission model, AI Passport uses our own vector database as its memory backend, built for fast, compact per-user memory and cryptographically enforced access control. We’re building first-party apps that give people reasons to create and use their Passport now, while also integrating it into consumer products with existing audiences across hospitality, travel, finance, and lifestyle.
companies.story: Egoist Machines 是一家做用户个人数据便携性的公司。想象你是一个经常使用各种人工智能应用的用户，每次换一个新应用，它都要从头了解你，推荐总是不准。Egoist Machines 正在构建一个叫 人工智能 Passport 的产品，让你可以把在一个应用里产生的个人背景信息，带到另一个应用里，新应用第一次就能懂你。你可以控制哪些信息可以分享，应用只能申请特定用途和时长的数据访问。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队两人。他们想解决人工智能应用个性化中的冷启动问题，让用户真正拥有自己的数据，这个方向值得关注。

companies.name: Proximitty
companies.originalOneLiner: AI operating system for commercial loans
companies.originalDescription: Proximitty is the AI operating system for commercial loans - we build regulator-grade AI agents that ingest and parse documents, spread financials, automate loan operations and track covenants. We help FDIC-insured banks and fintechs underwrite faster and scale their loan books without scaling costs.
companies.story: Proximitty 是一家做商业贷款人工智能操作系统的公司。想象你是一家社区银行的风控分析师，每天要处理大量贷款申请，手动阅读财务报表、核对文件、监管合规，忙得焦头烂额。Proximitty 开发了符合监管要求的人工智能智能体，可以自动解析文件、分析财务数据、操作贷款流程，还能监控贷款契约。这样银行就能更快地审批贷款，在不增加人手的情况下扩大贷款规模。这家公司来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，正在招聘，团队两人。对于受联邦存款保险公司监管的银行和金融科技公司来说，这个工具能显著提高效率。

companies.name: Convexia
companies.originalOneLiner: The world's first AI-maximalist pharma company
companies.originalDescription: An AI-maximalist pharma platform. We use agents to buy drugs, run clinical trials, and sell for a profit. 10x faster and 20x leaner than incumbents. Sourcing Agent: Mines public/private databases and unstructured global data to surface overlooked preclinical candidates. Scientific Agent: Runs comp bio models (ESM-3, RFdiffusion, Boltz-2, AlphaFold) to assess safety and efficacy in silico. Commercial Agent: Analyzes FDA incentives, pricing dynamics, TAM, competitive landscape, and payer alignment. Clinical Agent: Runs digital twin simulations, evaluates CRO/CMC risk, and builds trial plans to Phase 1. PoS Agent: Evaluates the most critical factors that impact the likelihood of clinical trial success. Built by 2 Stanford CS students who have built 3 startups together before.
companies.story: Convexia 是一家用人工智能做药物研发的公司。想象你是一个生物科技公司的研究主管，你发现了一个有潜力的药物分子，但不知道它能不能通过临床试验，值不值得投入。Convexia 用智能体来评估药物的安全性、有效性、商业前景和临床试验风险。它可以挖掘公共数据库，运行计算生物学模型，分析 FDA 激励政策，甚至模拟临床试验。这家公司由两位斯坦福计算机科学学生创立，他们之前合作过三次创业。来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队四人，正在招聘。他们声称比传统药企快十倍、精简二十倍，这个模式值得关注。

companies.name: Omanta
companies.originalOneLiner: A research lab for one
companies.originalDescription: Omanta is a personalized research lab for patients who have exhausted standard options, want to prepare proactively for recurrence, or are living with an unresolved diagnosis. We direct the full operational infrastructure, personnel, expertise, and technology of a large research program toward understanding and addressing the challenges of individual patients across oncology, rare disease, and undiagnosed conditions. For clinicians, we act as a collaborative partner, providing a living roadmap for ongoing patient care built on a rigorous and evolving scientific evidence base. We fully operationalize patient-specific research programs, covering tissue logistics, diagnostic follow-up, data integration, multiomic analysis, therapeutic strategy development, and more. Omanta brings context and clarity to complex cases, helping clinicians see more of the scientific picture as they decide how best to care for their patients.
companies.story: Omanta 是一家为患者提供个性化研究服务的公司。想象你是一个患有罕见病的病人，你试过了所有标准治疗，但都没有效果，医生也束手无策。Omanta 就像一个为你一个人开的科研实验室，它组织人员、设备和技术，专门研究你的病情，包括组织物流、诊断跟进、多组学分析和治疗方案制定。对临床医生来说，它像一个合作者，提供基于科学证据的持续护理路线图。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队四人。对于肿瘤、罕见病和未确诊疾病患者来说，这种个性化研究服务可能带来新的希望。

companies.name: HERA
companies.originalOneLiner: Hera is the design verification layer for heavy industry.
companies.originalDescription: At Hera, we build tools that help heavy engineering teams bring products to market up to 20× faster. Today, we work with manufacturers of data center ancillary equipment, renewable energy systems, robotics, heat exchangers, power plants and pressure vessels.
companies.story: HERA 是一家为重工业提供设计验证工具的公司。想象你是一个负责数据中心冷却系统设计的工程负责人，你的图纸上有一个尺寸标注错误，直到制造阶段才发现，导致返工和成本超支。HERA 的工具可以帮助你在设计阶段就验证图纸，避免这种问题。他们与数据中心辅助设备、可再生能源系统、机器人、热交换器、发电厂和压力容器的制造商合作。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队两人。对于重工业工程团队来说，这种设计验证层可以加快产品上市速度，值得关注。

companies.name: F4 Industries
companies.originalOneLiner: The GD&T Analysis Platform for Engineering Drawings
companies.originalDescription: GD&T takes years to master. Engineers must encode their design intent into a dense syntax that manufacturers must decode, and not everyone gets it right. Put ten engineers in front of the same drawing and you may get ten different interpretations. Which means errors often surface later in interface stack-ups, manufacturing, or in the field - when they’re far more expensive to fix. That’s why we built F4 - the platform that analyzes GD&T to determine whether your designs are ready for production. Drop in your drawing and 3D file. F4 analyzes every element of your GD&T to assess whether your design is clear, manufacturable, and production ready. To make the drawing easier to understand, engineers can visualize their datums, reference frames, and tolerance zones directly on the 3D model. F4 also calculates tolerance stack-ups instantly - directly from the drawing. What once took hours of manual work now takes seconds. When issues are found, F4 flags them and guides engineers toward resolving the problem. After analyzing your drawing, F4 also automatically generates design and inspection reports - stack-up tables, FAI reports - ready to share with your team. And it does all of this locally on-device with no AI used for analysis. Producing deterministic results engineers can trust.
companies.story: F4 Industries 是一家做工程图纸几何尺寸和公差分析平台的公司。想象你是一个机械设计工程师，你画了一张零件图，但不知道制造厂能不能看懂，也不知道公差会不会导致装配问题。F4 的平台可以分析你的图纸和 3D 模型，检查几何尺寸和公差标注是否清晰、可制造，还能在 3D 模型上可视化基准和公差带，并快速计算公差累积。以前需要几个小时的手工计算，现在瞬间完成。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队五人。对于需要确保设计可制造性的工程师来说，这个工具很有价值。

readings.title: Inside LinkedIn's cognitive memory agent for agentic personalization
readings.story: 当你打开一个购物网站，发现它记得你上次看过的商品，甚至能猜出你接下来想要什么，你可能会觉得这背后有个聪明的推荐系统。但真正做过这类功能的人知道，难的不是算法，而是怎么让系统记住你的偏好，又不会记错。LinkedIn 最近分享了一个他们正在尝试的思路，用类似记忆的方式来给每个用户建立个性化的认知。这篇文章值得一读，因为它讲的不只是技术方案，而是工程团队在真实产品里怎么权衡隐私、准确性和体验。读的时候可以留意，作者是怎么把抽象的记忆概念拆成具体可操作的模块，以及他们为什么选择这样的架构。

readings.title: India’s Airbound bags $37M to take on trucks with rocket-like drones
readings.story: 在印度拥挤的公路上，卡车运送货物常常被堵在车流里，有时候一堵就是几个小时。有人想到用无人机来送货，但大多数无人机只能带小包裹，飞不远。现在有一家叫 Airbound 的公司拿到了三千七百万美元的投资，想造一种像火箭一样的无人机，用来替代卡车跑长途运输。这个故事有意思的地方在于，它不只是讲融资数字，而是展示了一个创业公司怎么把航空技术和物流需求结合起来。读的时候可以想想，他们为什么觉得无人机能比卡车更划算，以及投资人看中的到底是什么样的市场机会。

readings.title: [AINews] Andrew Ng gets into AI Engineering
readings.story: 以前做软件的人，主要关心怎么写代码，让程序跑得快、不出错。但这两年人工智能火起来以后，很多人发现，真正难的不是训练模型，而是怎么把模型接到真实的应用里，让它稳定地干活。Andrew Ng 是机器学习领域的大牛，最近他也开始关注 人工智能 工程这个方向，这本身就是一个信号。这篇文章来自 Latent Space 的 人工智能 新闻汇总，读的时候可以看看，为什么连 Andrew Ng 都觉得工程实践比理论更重要，以及他提到的那些工具和方法，对普通开发者来说意味着什么。

companies.name: Simantic
companies.originalOneLiner: Firmware simulation for AI agents
companies.originalDescription: Simantic is modernizing the embedded firmware industry with hardware simulation developed for the adoption of AI in hardware engineering. Simantic gives both humans and AI the visibility into hardware previously limited by the physical world.
companies.story: Simantic 是一家为硬件工程提供固件模拟工具的初创公司，它让开发者能在虚拟环境中测试和调试嵌入式系统。想象你是一个嵌入式系统工程师，正在为一款新的智能设备编写固件，但每次调试都要连接物理硬件，不仅速度慢，还经常因为硬件故障而中断工作。Simantic 的模拟平台让你和人工智能智能体都能像操作真实硬件一样访问和控制虚拟设备，大大加快了开发周期。这家公司来自 YC 秋季批次，团队只有 4 人，但正在招聘，他们瞄准的是人工智能在硬件工程中的应用，这可能会改变未来硬件开发的模式。

companies.name: Control Seat
companies.originalOneLiner: Predictive maintenance on your plant data and sensors.
companies.originalDescription: Control Seat builds the hardware and software that helps industrial teams see, understand, and run their operations. Our platform creates one clear source of truth across the plant. It connects the systems teams already use, brings control, monitoring, history, and machine health together, and adds an intelligence layer that continuously watches for meaningful changes. Teams can understand what happened, catch problems earlier, and act before they become downtime. The result is fewer surprises, faster decisions, and less time spent piecing together information across disconnected tools. We work with manufacturers, utilities, energy companies, and other industrial operators modernizing existing facilities or building new ones.
companies.story: Control Seat 是一家为工业运营提供预测性维护平台的公司，它连接工厂现有的设备和传感器，创建一个统一的操作视图。假如你是一个工厂的运营负责人，每天最头疼的是设备突然停机导致的生产中断，你需要在故障发生前就预见到问题。Control Seat 的平台持续监控机器健康状态，并在异常出现时发出警告，让你能提前采取行动，避免停机。这家公司来自 YC 夏季批次，团队只有 2 人，但他们服务的领域包括制造业、公用事业和能源行业，这些行业对减少意外停机有迫切需求。

companies.name: Manicule
companies.originalOneLiner: AgentRel — Devrel For Agents
companies.originalDescription: Manicule does AgentRel. We get companies discovered and used by AI agents. Think DevRel, rebuilt for a world where agents make all the decisions. We own developer documentation and technical content across social channels, end-to-end. We've grown 100% MoM over the last three months to $53K in monthly revenue, with customers like Supermemory, Greptile, Reducto, and Mastra. Getting discovered and used by agents is its own job now, and the market for it is broken. The SEO/GEO SaaS tools just show you data like where you rank in AI answers. The agencies are slow and lack know-how with agents. The one person who could own all of it end-to-end, a DevRel, is nearly impossible to hire: our customers have had roles open for months at $300K+ and still can't find anyone good. We solve all these gaps. Naman has been doing fractional DevRel since he was 13, working with companies like PromptLayer, Brightdata, and Courier.com. Shreyans has been building since 14 — he built an AI app that hit App Store Productivity Trending within a month, and was the founding engineer at Supermemory. We met in high school and have built multiple startups together since.
companies.story: Manicule 是一家帮助企业被人工智能智能体发现和使用的公司，它提供的服务类似于开发者关系，但面向的是智能体时代。想象你是一个技术内容负责人，你的公司开发了一个优秀的开发者工具，但用户不再通过搜索引擎找产品，而是直接问人工智能助手，你的产品可能根本不会被提到。Manicule 帮你管理文档和技术内容，并优化它们在人工智能回答中的可见性。这家公司来自 YC 春季批次，团队 5 人，正在招聘，最近三个月收入每月增长 100%，月收入达到 5.3 万美元，客户包括 Supermemory、Greptile 等，显示这个新兴市场正在快速增长。

companies.name: Flai
companies.originalOneLiner: We Bring Customers to Your Dealership
companies.originalDescription: The problem we solve: 56% of dealership leads arrive after business hours, and most dealers lose these potential customers to competitors who happen to be available 24/7. Missing after-hours calls alone costs the average dealership $1M annually in lost revenue. We built Flai to fix this - AI assistants that answer dealership calls 24/7, scheduling test drives, oil changes, or running outbound recall campaigns so no opportunity slips away. The result: No more missed opportunities, no more losing customers to competitors. Our founding team has built voice AI products at HappyRobot, scaled infrastructure at Uber for millions of users, and applied data science at Netflix to solve operational challenges. We're not just answering phones, we're helping dealerships win in an AI-first world where availability determine who gets the sale.
companies.story: Flai 是一家为汽车经销商提供人工智能语音助手的公司，它解决经销商在非工作时间错失客户的问题。假设你是一个汽车经销商的销售经理，晚上 8 点后打来的客户电话经常无人接听，而这些客户很可能转向了其他经销商。Flai 的人工智能助手全天候接听电话，安排试驾和保养预约，甚至主动发起召回活动，确保每个潜在客户都不被遗漏。这家公司来自 YC 夏季批次，团队 23 人，正在招聘，创始团队有在 Uber 和 Netflix 工作的背景，他们声称平均每家经销商每年因错过下班后的电话损失高达 100 万美元。

companies.name: Manufact
companies.originalOneLiner: Cloud infrastructure for MCP servers and Claude / ChatGPT apps.
companies.originalDescription: Manufact is the MCP cloud platform to get your product ready for Claude Connectors marketplace, ChatGPT / Codex plugins store and any AI agent that supports MCP. We're the team behind mcp-use SDK, the open-source framework for building MCP Apps with 10k github stars and 8M+ downloads across python and typescript. It's the fastest and most complete solution for production-ready MCP servers.
companies.story: Manufact 是一家为 MCP 服务器和 Claude、ChatGPT 应用提供云基础设施的公司，它帮助开发者将产品接入主流人工智能平台。假如你是一个开发者，你开发了一个插件，希望能在 Claude 的 Connectors 市场或 ChatGPT 的插件商店上架，但你需要一个可靠的后端来支持 MCP 协议。Manufact 提供了现成的云平台，让你快速部署和扩展 MCP 服务器。这家公司来自 YC 夏季批次，团队 6 人，正在招聘，他们开发的开源框架 mcp-use 在 GitHub 上有 1 万星标，下载量超过 800 万，说明这个工具已经得到了广泛认可。

companies.name: Neuromorphic
companies.originalOneLiner: Building robots to automate wetlabs
companies.originalDescription: We are building robots that can work autonomously in existing wet labs. Unlike traditional lab automation, which requires dedicated equipment and fixed workflows, our robot moves between workstations, manipulates existing scientific equipment, transports lab materials, and executes experiments using the same lab infrastructure as a human technician. We make the robots easy to manage through natural interfaces like Slack, email, and phone. Our goal is to make deploying robots in wet labs as easy as onboarding a new employee.
companies.story: Neuromorphic 是一家制造能在现有湿实验室中自主工作的机器人的公司，它让实验室自动化不再需要昂贵的专用设备。想象你是一个生物技术公司的实验室经理，你希望提高实验效率，但传统的自动化系统需要固定工作流程和专用设备，改造起来非常麻烦。Neuromorphic 的机器人可以在实验台之间移动，操作现有的科学仪器，并通过 Slack 或电子邮件等自然界面进行管理，就像雇佣了一个新的实验员。这家公司来自 YC 夏季批次，团队 3 人，他们专注于让机器人在现有实验室环境中工作，这可能大幅降低自动化门槛。

companies.name: Axis
companies.originalOneLiner: An AI Copilot for Trading Desks
companies.originalDescription: Axis is building an AI Native Trading System, allowing a trader to deploy models that monitor and analyze relevant markets and strategies. We've chosen commodities as our first market. Commodities make up a third of global goods exports, and physical commodities traders decide the movement and storage of metals, agricultural products, and energy across the globe. They trade in public markets and bilateral OTC agreements. Engaging in these markets is complexing, covering derivatives positioning, refinery data, storage inventory, import/exports, geopolitical events and more. Axis is building an AI driven analytical layer for these markets.
companies.story: Axis 是一家为大宗商品交易员打造人工智能副驾驶的公司，它帮助交易员监控市场并分析策略。想象你是一个大宗商品交易员，每天需要处理大量数据，包括衍生品持仓、炼油厂数据、库存、进出口和地缘政治事件，信息过载让你难以做出及时决策。Axis 的人工智能系统能够持续分析这些市场，并提供洞察。这家公司来自 YC 冬季批次，团队 2 人，他们选择大宗商品作为第一个市场，因为这个市场占全球商品出口的三分之一，交易复杂且信息分散，人工智能分析层可能带来显著优势。

companies.name: Novaflow
companies.originalOneLiner: The AI data analyst for biology labs
companies.originalDescription: Novaflow is the AI data analyst for biology labs. -- Bioinformatics data analysis is a time-consuming and expensive process for scientists. With Novaflow, life scientists can upload experimental data, ask questions in plain English, and get instant, publication-ready plots, giving them results in minutes instead of months. Researchers at leading institutions like UCSF, Mount Sinai, UC Berkeley, and Harvard are already using Novaflow in their labs.
companies.story: Novaflow 是一家为生物学实验室提供人工智能数据分析师的公司，它让科学家能用自然语言提问并获得出版级图表。假设你是一个生物信息学研究员，你刚完成一次实验，得到了大量测序数据，但分析这些数据需要数周时间，而且需要编写复杂的代码。Novaflow 让你直接上传数据，用中文或英文提问，几分钟内就能得到可视化结果。这家公司来自 YC 夏季批次，团队 5 人，正在招聘，他们的产品已被 UCSF、哈佛等顶尖机构使用，说明它在生命科学领域有实际价值。

companies.name: b12 Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: Making hard molecules for Pharma and Biotech
companies.originalDescription: b12 makes high-value molecules that are otherwise hard to make. We help pharma companies plan and make new drugs, accelerating early-stage drug discovery from years to months. Andres built the first AI agent that can autonomously think and make molecules in a robotic lab, published in Nature Machine Intelligence (1000+ citations), and won the best paper award at the NeurIPS AI for Science conference. Zlatko is a 3x National Chemistry Olympiad champion, competed at IChO level, and medicinal chemist who has worked at Roche and leading lab robotics companies. Combined, we have an extensive network of hundreds of chemists, automation scientists, and AI 4 Science researchers. We run paid pilots with big pharma companies, demonstrating that our platform planned a set of experiments that achieved full conversion in a single attempt, eliminating the iteration cycle.
companies.story: b12 Labs 是一家为制药和生物技术公司制造难以合成的分子的公司，它结合人工智能和机器人技术加速药物发现。想象你是一个药物化学家，你设计了一个有潜力的候选药物，但合成它需要经过多步复杂的化学反应，传统方法可能耗时数月。b12 的机器人实验室可以自主规划并执行合成实验，将时间缩短到几周。这家公司来自 YC 夏季批次，团队 3 人，正在招聘，创始人之一曾发表过关于人工智能自主合成分子的论文，并获得 NeurIPS 最佳论文奖，他们还与大型制药公司开展了付费试点。

companies.name: Veritus
companies.originalOneLiner: AI agents for the consumer lending industry
companies.originalDescription: Veritus is a omni-channel platform for deploying AI agents for loan servicing and collections, including inbound and outbound voice agents. Our agents negotiate repayment plans, follow up across channels, and drive recoveries with zero human involvement. By combining cutting edge voice AI with deep regulatory compliance and vertical specialization we're able to drastically reduce the cost-to-collect while increasing recovery rates.
companies.story: Veritus 是一家为消费贷款行业提供人工智能智能体的公司，它通过语音和全渠道平台处理贷款服务和催收。假如你是一家贷款公司的催收主管，你手下有一批催收员，每天需要打数百个电话，但效率低且成本高。Veritus 的人工智能智能体可以自动与借款人协商还款计划，并通过电话、短信等渠道跟进，无需人工干预。这家公司来自 YC 夏季批次，团队 10 人，正在招聘，他们结合语音人工智能和合规知识，旨在降低催收成本并提高回收率。

readings.title: Who’s behind the new ‘stealth model’ Ox Alpha?
readings.story: 人工智能领域每隔一段时间就会冒出一个神秘的新模型，名字听着像代号，背后的团队却藏在幕布后面。普通用户可能只是在新闻里瞥一眼，觉得又是一场炒作；但真正关心技术走向的人会好奇，是谁在投入巨额算力，又是谁在赌一个还没有公开验证的方向。这篇报道恰好把镜头对准了这样一个新面孔，它想解释的不是模型本身有多厉害，而是它为什么会在此时出现，以及背后站着哪些力量。读的时候，不妨留意作者如何从零星的线索里拼出全貌，又是怎么判断哪些信息是实质，哪些只是烟雾弹。这样你就能明白，一个看似遥远的行业新闻，其实和每个人未来会用到什么工具有关。

readings.title: Stripe Buys OpenRouter for $7B, Anthropic Turns Its First Profit, and Silver Lake Circles Workday at $43B: 20VC x SaaStr
readings.story: 你可能已经习惯了每天打开手机，用各种应用完成支付、对话或者办公，但很少会去想，这些服务背后正在发生怎样的资本运作。某一天，你会发现一家熟悉的支付公司突然收购了一个小工具，或者一家一直亏损的人工智能公司宣布盈利了，又或者一个老牌软件厂商被传要易主。这些消息凑在一起，容易让人眼花缭乱，但背后其实是同一个逻辑：行业正在重新洗牌。这篇文章把这些看似独立的事件放在一起讨论，像一位老练的观察者，带你看看资本和战略在如何悄悄改变你日常使用的产品。读的时候，可以关注作者怎么把这些交易串成一条线，以及他提醒了哪些容易被忽略的细节，这样你就能对行业的走向有自己的判断。

readings.title: How to close $100K+ enterprise deals, step by step | Jen Abel
readings.story: 对很多做销售或者创业的人来说，谈成一笔十万美金以上的企业订单，听起来像是一个遥远的目标，但真正难的不是金额，而是过程中那些琐碎又关键的步骤。你可能已经见过了各种销售技巧，但到了实际推进的时候，还是会卡在某个环节：不知道找谁拍板，不知道报价怎么出，不知道合同怎么谈。这篇文章请来了一位有实战经验的人，她愿意把整个过程一步一步拆开讲。读的时候，不妨把自己代入那个正在跟进大客户的销售角色，看看作者在每一个节点是怎么做决定的，尤其是那些容易被忽略的细节，比如怎么判断客户的真实预算，怎么在多方周旋时保持主动权。这样你学到的就不是空泛的道理，而是能直接用在下一场谈判里的思路。

companies.name: Corelayer
companies.originalOneLiner: AI production engineer for regulated industries
companies.originalDescription: Corelayer is the AI-native platform for production software support, built for regulated industries like finance and healthcare. It continuously monitors alerts, logs, infrastructure, and underlying data for issues and uses agents to debug and suggest fixes. We're helping SRE, production services, and on-call engineers at companies ranging from growth-stage fintechs to Fortune 500 financial institutions spend less time on support and more on high-leverage work.
companies.story: Corelayer 是一家为金融、医疗等监管严格行业打造人工智能生产支持平台的公司。想象你是一位负责线上支付系统的值班工程师，凌晨两点被警报吵醒，日志、指标和告警铺天盖地，却一时找不到根因。Corelayer 持续监控这些信号，用智能体自动排查问题并给出修复建议，让你从繁琐的故障排查中解脱出来，把精力放在更有价值的工作上。这家公司来自 YC 冬季批次，团队虽小，但瞄准的正是大银行和成长型金融科技公司都头疼的生产支持痛点，值得关注。

companies.name: Kestrel AI
companies.originalOneLiner: AI Agents for Platform Engineering
companies.originalDescription: Kestrel is the AI automation layer for platform engineering teams. Platform teams use Kestrel to automate incident response, cloud provisioning, CI/CD, security, and developer requests across their stack. Kestrel turns natural-language prompts into deterministic, production-ready workflows with 40+ integrations, 200+ pre-built actions, and support for custom HTTP and webhook actions. Developer-first, with a CLI, Python SDK, and MCP server to manage workflows from where platform teams already work.
companies.story: Kestrel AI 做的是平台工程团队的人工智能自动化层。假如你是一个平台工程师，每天要处理大量重复的开发者请求、云资源开通和故障响应，忙得不可开交。Kestrel 能把自然语言指令变成可靠的生产级工作流，内置四十多种集成和两百多个预置操作，还支持自定义接口。你可以通过命令行、Python 工具包或 MCP 服务器来管理这些流程，不用离开熟悉的工作环境。这家公司来自 YC 秋季批次，团队虽小，但切中了平台工程自动化的真实需求。

companies.name: Caution
companies.location: George Town, George Town, Cayman Islands
companies.originalOneLiner: Hosting platform for software you don't want to have hacked
companies.originalDescription: Caution is a hosting platform for software you can't afford to get hacked. It simplifies and extends confidential compute, and lets developers deploy workloads to secure enclaves in minutes and give customers, auditors, and counterparties cryptographic proof that production is running the exact reviewed source code, build, configuration, and runtime - not an opaque binary controlled by a cloud operator or internal admin. Confidential computing hardware exists, but the tooling is too fragmented and incomplete for most teams to use well. Today, attestation often proves only that a binary has a certain hash; it does not prove what source code produced that binary. Building the missing deployment, reproducibility, and verification layer requires specialized security engineering and often locks teams into one cloud or hardware stack. Caution turns that into a simple git-based workflow that builds reproducible enclave images, provisions infrastructure, and lets anyone independently verify what is running. We built Caution after years securing high-risk systems through Distrust, where we worked with hedge funds, custodians, blockchain teams, cloud platforms, and critical grid operators on systems responsible for more than $600B in assets. Again and again, the same problem showed up: teams running mission-critical infrastructure could not reliably prove what was executing in production. As AI, fintech, healthcare, and regulated data collaboration move into the cloud, "trust us" is no longer enough. Caution is a general-purpose platform: if it runs on a server, it can run verifiably on Caution. We're starting where trust failures cost the most, but we believe verifiable compute will become the default way software runs, the same way HTTPS became the default way it's served. Infrastructure you can verify, not trust.
companies.story: Caution 是一个托管平台，专门用来部署那些绝对不能出安全问题的软件。想象你是一家金融科技公司的安全负责人，客户要求你证明生产环境运行的就是经过审查的源代码，而不是一个无法验证的二进制文件。Caution 利用机密计算技术，让你在几分钟内把工作负载部署到安全 enclave，并提供加密证明，让客户、审计师和交易对手都能验证代码、配置和运行时的真实性。这家公司来自 YC 夏季批次，团队五人，在云安全和合规领域填补了一个关键空白。

companies.name: Soria
companies.originalOneLiner: AI Financial Research Terminal built for Healthcare (and beyond)
companies.originalDescription: Soria is an AI-native Financial Terminal for investors who specialize in a particular sector, starting with healthcare. Our agents convert hundreds of the most important public and private sources into an always-on financial model, reviewed by domain experts and delivered to hedge funds, banks, and asset managers through a terminal UI, MCP, API, warehouse sync, and research feed. Unlike our competitors, we own the data layer and expand bottom-up, one sector at a time - additionally our agents proactively do research on behalf of our clients without them lifting a finger or sharing any data.
companies.story: Soria 是一个面向专业投资者的金融研究终端，先从医疗行业切入。如果你是一位医疗板块的基金经理，每天要阅读大量研报、会议纪要和临床试验数据，还要更新财务模型，非常耗时。Soria 的智能体能把数百个公开和私有来源的信息整合成一个持续更新的财务模型，由领域专家审核，并通过终端界面、接口、数据仓库同步等方式推送给你。这家公司来自 YC 春季批次，正在招聘，团队三人，他们自己掌握数据层，按行业逐步扩展，值得关注。

companies.name: Risklytics
companies.originalOneLiner: Insurance for the Frontier
companies.originalDescription: Risklytics is a commercial insurance brokerage for frontier tech: robotics, autonomy, data centers, and energy infrastructure. Insurers are writing AI exclusions into standard liability forms, so companies whose products act in the physical world end up holding risk they thought they had transferred. We specialize in that gap, and we know which carriers in the admitted and surplus lines markets will still underwrite it. If you're building anything that moves, lifts, drives, or powers something, we'd like to talk.
companies.story: Risklytics 是一家面向前沿科技的商业保险经纪公司，专注于机器人、自动驾驶、数据中心和能源基础设施。想象你是一家机器人公司的创始人，产品即将交付，却发现自己买的保险里有人工智能除外条款，风险并没有真正转移。Risklytics 专门处理这种风险缺口，知道哪些保险公司在标准市场和超额市场愿意承保。如果你在造会动、会举、会开或会供电的东西，他们能帮你找到合适的保险。这家公司来自 YC 夏季批次，团队两人，切中了一个新兴且棘手的领域。

companies.name: Exonic
companies.originalOneLiner: Unsupervised Biological AI
companies.originalDescription: What if you could train a biological foundation model on... the entire internet? Exonic is pioneering a new generation of biological foundation models, focused on heterogeneous, unstructured, and noisy datasets. Our first application is the design of safer gene therapies. In 2025, we used AI to set a new state of the art in liver cancer targeted gene therapy, validated in vitro in our lab in San Francisco. So far in 2026, we have trained a new model with unprecedented zero-shot generalization on genomic regulatory expression in hold-out biosample datasets. More to be shared soon.
companies.story: Exonic 正在探索用互联网上的海量数据训练生物基础模型。想象你是一位基因治疗研究员，正在设计更安全的疗法，却苦于现有模型对复杂生物数据的处理能力有限。Exonic 的模型在零样本泛化上表现出色，能处理异质、非结构化和有噪声的数据，并在肝癌靶向基因治疗上取得了进展，已在旧金山实验室验证。这家公司来自 YC 秋季批次，正在招聘，团队三人，他们的研究可能为基因治疗带来新突破。

companies.name: Lumius
companies.originalOneLiner: Fast, smart, accessible 3D ultrasound that anyone can use
companies.originalDescription: Ultrasound today is still mostly 2D. Clinicians have to imagine the 3D anatomy in their head while also moving the probe at the same time. This makes procedures like vascular access hard to learn and perform consistently, especially for beginners. ~50% fail on their first attempt. Hospitals also spend millions each year on 2D ultrasound training. Meanwhile, existing 3D ultrasound devices can cost >10× as much. Lumius is building fast, smart, and accessible 3D ultrasound systems to eliminate this 2D guesswork. Our technology shows a clear, real-time 3D view of what’s inside the body. It works over a large volume, not just a thin slice. The device is also affordable, compact, and portable. We are starting with vascular access, especially central line. Future use cases include blood clot detection, tumor diagnosis, and biopsy guidance. Our long-term vision is a universal 3D ultrasound platform that brings easy-to-use, real-time imaging to a wide range of clinical and eventually consumer applications.
companies.story: Lumius 正在开发快速、智能且人人都能用的三维超声设备。想象你是一位急诊科医生，要给病人做中心静脉置管，传统二维超声需要你在脑中想象三维解剖结构，新手往往要试好几次才能成功。Lumius 的设备能实时显示清晰的三维图像，覆盖大范围体积，而且价格亲民、小巧便携。它先从血管穿刺应用开始，未来可能扩展到血栓检测、肿瘤诊断和活检引导。这家公司来自 YC 春季批次，正在招聘，团队四人，他们想用三维超声消除二维的猜测。

companies.name: Sunflower
companies.originalOneLiner: Building the Sobriety Platform for the future of Superintelligence. 🌻
companies.originalDescription: Sunflower is on a mission to create one trillion days sober. Our product is both a consumer app (think a "Duolingo for addiction") but also with a tele-therapy clinic inside. Consumer App: - We built the #1 AI Sponsor for any kind of addiction - Beautiful visual progression tracking to power the core "task to be done" of addiction - A twitter style social media for addicts - DIY learn content (think Masterclass for addiction) for all major addiction types - CBT based journaling exercises Tele-Therapy: - Think a "Early Medical Peter Attia" quality of clinic, but completely focused on addiction - Starting with talk therapy in CA & TX we're rolling out to all 50 states + MAT - Bringing together the worlds best doctors to create the most effective protocol for addiction Sunflower went from 0 - 100k MAU in less than 6 months, and now we're continuing the traction to create the #1 product for addiction for the 1.2B humans on this planet that struggle with this fundamental human problem.
companies.story: Sunflower 是一个帮助人们戒除成瘾的平台，既有类似多邻国的消费应用，也内置了远程治疗诊所。想象你是一个正在戒酒的人，每天都要和冲动对抗，需要有人随时支持。Sunflower 提供人工智能赞助者、视觉进度追踪、成瘾者社交网络、自助学习内容和认知行为疗法日记练习，同时还有专业的远程治疗服务，从加州和得克萨斯州开始，逐步扩展到全美。这家公司来自 YC 夏季批次，团队十五人，应用在不到六个月里达到十万月活用户，他们想创造十亿个清醒日。

companies.name: RonanRx Inc.
companies.originalOneLiner: We use AI to personalize peptides to your biology
companies.originalDescription: RonanRX helps you personalize GLP-1s like Ozempic, peptides, and other treatments using your labs, wearables, medical history, treatment response, and the latest medical research. Instead of treating the average patient, we continuously personalize your treatment as your body changes. We've built the complete feedback loop for personalized medicine: your health data automatically syncs into one place, AI helps personalize treatment, licensed doctors make prescribing decisions, medications are delivered to your door, and every outcome continuously improves your protocol. Connect your health data once. RonanRX automatically syncs your labs, wearables, and medical records into a single AI-powered health profile that helps personalize GLP-1s like Ozempic, peptides, supplements, and other treatments around your biology. If prescribed, your medication is delivered to your door. Our founders have built and exited multiple companies, raised over $100M, and previously built a $50M U.S. medical manufacturing business. Start with a text at RonanRX.com and become the maximum version of yourself,
companies.story: RonanRx 利用人工智能根据你的生物学特征个性化定制 GLP-1 药物（如司美格鲁肽）和其他肽类治疗。想象你是一个正在使用减肥药的患者，体重下降却遇到了平台期，还担心副作用。RonanRx 自动同步你的化验数据、可穿戴设备和病历，构建一个人工智能健康档案，医生根据这些信息调整你的用药方案，药物直接送到家，每次治疗结果都会反馈到档案里，不断优化。这家公司来自 YC 夏季批次，团队五人，他们想实现真正的个性化医疗闭环。

companies.name: Archer
companies.originalOneLiner: Global payouts for the workforce powering AI
companies.originalDescription: Archer is the financial infrastructure for the AI data economy. We’re building global payouts, stablecoin banking, and yield infrastructure for the companies supplying data to frontier AI labs. As demand for high-quality data grows, millions of contributors around the world are generating, labeling, validating, and improving the datasets that power modern AI systems. Yet the financial infrastructure behind these platforms remains slow, fragmented, and expensive. Archer enables data marketplaces, AI labor platforms, and reinforcement learning environment providers to onboard workers globally, pay contributors instantly, and earn yield on idle balances. Today, companies use Archer to manage contributor earnings, global payouts, and treasury operations across hundreds of countries and payment corridors. We believe the next generation of AI companies will need purpose-built financial infrastructure. Just as cloud providers became the backbone of software, Archer is building the financial layer for the global workforce powering artificial intelligence.
companies.story: Archer 是为人工智能数据经济打造的金融基础设施，提供全球支付、稳定币银行和收益服务。想象你是一家数据标注平台的创始人，有成千上万的全球贡献者为你工作，但支付给他们却要经过缓慢且昂贵的跨境转账。Archer 让你能快速、低成本地支付给全球员工，还能让闲置余额产生收益。这家公司来自 YC 春季批次，团队四人，他们看到了人工智能劳动力金融服务的巨大空白，想要为下一代人工智能公司提供专用金融支持。

readings.title: Show HN: Zuse" One agent coordinating 20 Linear issues in worktrees
readings.story: 一个人同时盯二十个任务，每个任务还各自开着独立的工作区，这在很多工程师看来是手忙脚乱的起点。过去大家要么靠脚本硬撑，要么靠人肉切换分支，稍不留神就乱了套。这篇在技术社区热起来的帖子，讲的正是有人试着让一个智能体去协调这些乱糟糟的活。它值得读，是因为它把“人工智能 能不能真正干活”这个空泛的问题，落到了很具体的场景里。读的时候不妨留意，作者是怎么把二十个任务拆给一个智能体去管的，是简单堆权限，还是真的理清了任务之间的依赖关系，这往往才是能不能跑通的关键。

readings.title: Two years after launch, Walmart’s Flipkart is closing in on India’s quick-commerce leaders
readings.story: 印度街头那些承诺几分钟送到家的小店，这两年突然成了大公司争抢的战场。你打开手机下单，半小时内东西就上门，这种便利背后是仓储、配送和算法的层层比拼。这篇报道讲的是沃尔玛旗下的 Flipkart 入场两年后，居然快要追上那些先跑一步的对手。它值得读，是因为它把“快商务”这个热词，拆成了实实在在的运营细节。读的时候可以盯着看，作者是怎么解释后来者追上的原因，是砸钱补贴，还是找到了更聪明的配送路径，这比单纯看市场份额有意思得多。

readings.title: 🧠 Community Wisdom: Favorite Lenny’s Product Pass tools, how AI is reshaping hiring, what to prioritize when you join a new company, and more
readings.story: 刚进一家新公司，面前堆着几十个工具和流程，你根本不知道先学哪个；另一边，HR 们正为简历筛选发愁，人工智能 似乎能帮忙却总怕看走眼。这些零碎的问题，恰好是 Lenny 这份社区问答合集想碰的。它把产品经理、设计师和创业者在日常里反复纠结的小事，比如用什么工具、怎么排优先级，集中起来让有经验的人回答。它值得读，是因为答案来自真实工作场景，而不是教科书。读的时候可以挑一两个你最近头疼的问题，看看大家给出的取舍逻辑，说不定能帮你换个角度想事情。

companies.name: Alkera AI
companies.originalOneLiner: Reliable and safe data engineering and data science agents
companies.originalDescription: Alkera is a data engineering/analysis/science agent that works in your IDE or CLI. If you’re tired of agents that produce false, or even dangerous, reports about your data, then Alkera is for you. Our agent is equipped with your data’s history and lineage, your team’s knowledge, and tailored plugins for data apps such as Snowflake and dbt. Simply install and connect your services to begin doing trusted agentic data work. We also offer VPC & on-prem deployment options for when data can't leave your boundary.
companies.story: 这是一家做数据工程和数据分析智能体的公司。想象你是一位数据工程师，每天要处理大量数据请求，最怕智能体给出错误甚至危险的分析报告。Alkera 的智能体直接运行在你的开发环境或命令行里，它了解你的数据历史和数据血缘，还带着你团队的知识，以及针对 Snowflake 和 dbt 这类数据应用的定制插件。你只需安装并连接服务，就能开始可信的智能体数据工作。它还提供 VPC 和本地部署选项，当数据不能离开你的边界时也能用。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队只有三个人，但专注于解决智能体在数据领域可靠性的痛点。

companies.name: Locus
companies.originalOneLiner: Payment infrastructure for AI agents
companies.originalDescription: We make your agents pay. As agents evolve from tools into dependable, autonomous actors, they’ll need the ability to execute open-ended workflows end-to-end. This inevitably means payments: accessing paywalled data, transacting for services or with other specialist agents. But autonomy requires guardrails. Businesses and developers will need a way to ensure their agents only spend how much and on what they’re supposed to. The machine economy is coming, and Locus (YC F25) is building the connector businesses will need to participate. We connect agents securely to funds, letting you define permissions and limits for every transaction. Each payment is traceable, auditable, and fully reconcilable with your existing financial stack.
companies.story: Locus 做的是人工智能智能体的支付基础设施。想象你是一个开发智能体的工程师，你的智能体需要访问付费数据、购买服务，或者与其他智能体交易，但你又担心它乱花钱。Locus 让你可以为每一笔交易设定权限和限额，智能体只能花你允许的金额，而且每笔支付都可追踪、可审计，并和你现有的财务系统对账。这家公司来自 YC 秋季 2025 批次，团队两人，他们看到了机器经济的到来，正在建设连接器，让企业和开发者安全地参与其中。

companies.name: Cardinal
companies.originalOneLiner: Revenue Agents for GTM teams
companies.originalDescription: Hey YC! We're Devi and Jianna - the founders of Cardinal. Hey guys! We’re launching Cardinal publicly today - co’s like Mintlify, Deepgram, Giga, etc. use us to build revenue agents & design how they sell. The Problem “Spray and Pray” outbound is dead. The best teams at outbound do it with extreme precision. Finding things in common with your customers, staying in touch with them through their content, mapping inbound from signups and ads, tracking website visitors, monitoring various signals, etc. This sounds great in theory, but in reality involves stringing together 10+ tools and hiring a GTM engineer. That’s where Cardinal comes in. Cardinal is an AI platform for precision outbound. Our agents can create workflows that normally require the work of fulltime GTM engineers. If you're a founder or sales leader looking to bring AI into your sales org, would love to chat!
companies.story: Cardinal 是一个面向销售团队的人工智能收入智能体平台。想象你是一家公司的销售主管，你发现传统的盲目外呼已经失效，顶尖团队都在做精准外呼，但你需要整合十多个工具，还要雇一个专门做销售运营的工程师。Cardinal 的智能体能帮你创建工作流，完成以前需要全职销售运营工程师才能做的事情，比如寻找与客户的共同点、跟踪他们的内容、映射注册和广告带来的线索、监控网站访客等。这家公司来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，正在招聘，已经有一些公司如 Mintlify、Deepgram、Giga 在使用。

companies.name: KelAI
companies.originalOneLiner: The AI Quant: Autonomous Alpha Engine for Funds and Traders.
companies.originalDescription: Founded by former WorldQuant portfolio manager & head of event driven systematic strategies Jeremie Cohen, KelAI is building the autonomous alpha engine for hedge funds, traders and institutional investors. Investment teams now have more data, tools and compute than ever, but research still runs across siloed systems and inefficient workflows. KelAI turns that fragmented process into a compounding AI-native engine that continuously finds, tests and validates trading signals at a pace no human team can match.
companies.story: KelAI 正在为基金和交易者构建自主的阿尔法引擎。想象你是一位量化研究员，每天面对海量数据，但研究过程分散在不同的系统和低效的工作流中。KelAI 把这个碎片化的过程变成一个持续发现、测试和验证交易信号的引擎，速度远超人类团队。这家公司由前 WorldQuant 投资组合经理创立，来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队三人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Arctic Health
companies.originalOneLiner: AI-native credentialing and contracting for healthcare
companies.originalDescription: Arctic Health is building AI-native credentialing and contracting for healthcare organizations. We automate the full workflow, from establishing payer contracts to enrolling each provider. We collect and validate organization and provider data according to each state and payer’s requirements, and submit on the organization's behalf. We then monitor status and compliance on an ongoing basis. Tools on the market today either perform small pieces of the workflow or price out small and mid-sized organizations. We handle the process end-to-end regardless of organization type or size. Our browser automations enable AI agents to submit and monitor across hundreds of payer portals, and our system is trained by experienced industry experts who handle every edge case. Healthcare organizations get one simple platform. We handle the rest.
companies.story: Arctic Health 做的是面向医疗机构的人工智能原生的认证和签约服务。想象你是一家小型诊所的运营负责人，你需要与保险公司签约，并为每位医生完成认证，这个过程繁琐且要求严格。Arctic Health 自动化了整个流程，从建立付款人合同到注册每个提供者，它收集和验证组织与提供者数据，根据各州和付款人的要求提交，并持续监控状态和合规性。它的浏览器自动化让智能体可以在数百个付款人门户上提交和监控，系统由经验丰富的行业专家训练，处理各种边缘情况。这家公司来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队四人。

companies.name: ANORIA
companies.originalOneLiner: The first wearable that reads your emotions to enhance your EQ.
companies.originalDescription: We've spent decades tracking everything. Sleep. Recovery. Steps. All proxies for how we feel. Performance is 90% mental. And yet no one has built the feedback loop for our emotions. We close that loop by designing a device that understands how you feel, tells you why, and what you can do about it. Emotional intelligence becomes trainable, so you can better connect and create with those around you.
companies.story: ANORIA 是一款能读取你情绪的可穿戴设备，旨在提升你的情商。想象你是一个工作压力很大的咨询顾问，你每天要开很多会，你总感觉自己的情绪影响表现，但你不清楚具体是为什么。ANORIA 能理解你的感受，告诉你原因，并建议你如何应对。它不只是一个手机应用，而是把能力放进一个设备里，让你随身佩戴，实时捕捉生理信号，从而训练你的情绪智力。这家公司来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队五人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Covera
companies.originalOneLiner: AI-native OS for insurance brokers
companies.originalDescription: Covera builds AI agents for insurance brokers. Our ready-to-use agents take over the day-to-day servicing work: submission intake, carrier quoting, quote comparison, claims handling, past-due collections, and account rounding. That means brokers can spend their time advising and selling clients instead of doing data entry. We work with agencies of every size and connect natively to the tools they already use.
companies.story: Covera 为保险经纪人构建人工智能智能体。想象你是一个保险经纪人，你每天要处理大量日常服务工作，比如提交申请、获取报价、比较报价、处理索赔、追讨逾期款项，这些繁琐的数据录入占用了你大量时间。Covera 的智能体可以接管这些工作，让你专注于为客户提供建议和销售。这家公司来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队两人，正在招聘，它连接经纪人已经使用的工具，并适用于各种规模的机构。

companies.name: Galactic Resource Utilization Space, Inc. (GRU Space)
companies.originalOneLiner: Moon Hotel -> The Intergalactic Construction Company of Earth
companies.originalDescription: GRU Space is building permanent lunar infrastructure to make humanity interplanetary within our lifetime, starting with the first hotel on the Moon. In just 6 weeks, we built the world's first Moon factory: patent-pending hardware that turns lunar regolith into bricks and inflates modular pressurized habitats designed to withstand lunar temperature and pressure extremes. Our first mission lands on the Moon in 2027 to demonstrate in-situ brick manufacturing and habitat deployment. A second mission lays the hotel's foundation inside a lunar cave, and a third opens the first lunar hotel, targeted for 2032. We don’t stop at Moon hotels. GRU’s long-term plan: 1. Build the first hotel on the Moon. GRU solves off‑world surface habitation. 2. Become the Moon Base Company of America: build roads, mass drivers, warehouses, and physical infrastructure. 3. Repeat on Mars and build the first cities there. 4. Own property on the Moon and Mars as these economies grow. 5. Reinvest profits into resource utilization systems on the Moon, Mars, asteroids, and beyond—reaching our final form: Galactic Resource Utilization. GRU Space is backed by investors in SpaceX and Anduril, is part of Nvidia's Inception program, and our launch generated 1B+ views across 60+ countries, earning invitations to the White House, Senate, and Pentagon.
companies.story: GRU Space 正在建设月球永久基础设施，目标是让人类在你有生之年成为跨行星物种。想象你是一位月球基地的工程负责人，你需要在月球表面建造能抵御极端温度和压力的栖息地。GRU Space 开发了专利硬件，可以把月球风化层变成砖块，并充气展开模块化加压栖息地。它的首个任务计划在 2027 年登陆月球，演示现场制砖和栖息地部署。这家公司来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队五人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Playgent
companies.originalOneLiner: Sandboxes for AI agents
companies.originalDescription: When enterprise agents fail in production, the conditions that caused the failure are critical: user state, data, tool calls, and context. Without a way to recreate these conditions, teams can't fix what broke. Playgent provides infrastructure to create high-fidelity sandbox environments for AI agents. Our environments come packaged as a single MCP url where tool calls are mocked, authentication is abstracted away, and test data can be initialized via natural language or JSON specifications. Teams can use Playgent to reproduce production failures in safe, scoped environments that accurately reconstruct state. Finally, export runs as OTel traces from Playgent's environment to plug directly into your observability tools or RL pipelines.
companies.story: Playgent 为人工智能智能体提供沙盒环境。想象你是一个负责企业智能体运维的工程师，当智能体在生产环境失败时，你需要重现当时的用户状态、数据、工具调用和上下文，否则无法修复。Playgent 提供高保真沙盒，你可以用自然语言或 JSON 初始化测试数据，工具调用被模拟，认证被抽象，让你安全地重现故障。它来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队两人，专注于解决智能体在生产环境中的可观测性问题。

companies.name: Manifold
companies.originalOneLiner: Low-cost, deployment-ready robotic labor for warehouses
companies.originalDescription: The US Warehouse industry spends $75bn on labor each year. Yet, only 10% of US warehouses have any form of automation, because existing robotics are too expensive and hard to integrate. Manifold deploys autonomous robots that handle picking, loading / unloading, and palletizing — priced by pick. Integration in hours. No upfront costs. No retrofitting. No need to rebuild the operation around the robot. Our mission is to make it easy for any warehouse to adopt robotics.
companies.story: Manifold 为仓库提供低成本的机器人劳动力。想象你是一个仓库主管，你每年在劳动力上花费巨大，但现有机器人太贵且难以集成，所以只有少数仓库实现了自动化。Manifold 部署自主机器人，负责拣选、装卸和码垛，按件计费，集成只需几小时，无需前期成本，也无需改造现有运营。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队两人，他们想让任何仓库都能轻松采用机器人。

readings.title: [AINews] 10% worse, 100x cheaper, 10000x faster: Why Simulation is taking over
readings.story: 做人工智能的人经常被算力账单吓一跳，训练一次模型的钱够买好几辆车。于是有人开始琢磨，能不能不真跑那么多遍，先在电脑里模拟一个世界，让模型在里面练手。这篇讲的就是这种思路为什么突然流行起来。它不直接说哪个技术更厉害，而是把成本、速度和效果放在一起比，让人看清一条新的取舍路径。读的时候可以留意作者怎么解释“便宜”和“好用”之间的关系，以及哪些公司会最先尝到甜头。

readings.title: Michael Polansky is training an AI model on skin that’s still alive
readings.story: 你可能听说过用照片训练人工智能，但有没有想过，直接拿还活着的皮肤组织来训练？这不是科幻片，而是真有人在做的事。听起来有点吓人，但背后其实是在解决一个实际问题：机器怎么理解真实的触感，而不是纸上画的示意图。这篇报道带我们走进这个有点前沿的实验室，看他们怎么把生物样本变成数据。读的时候不用急着评判伦理，先看科学家如何把复杂的生物过程拆成模型能学的东西，这个思路本身就很值得琢磨。

readings.title: Say it once: introducing Bot Preference Sync
readings.story: 运营网站的人都有这种经历：明明设置了拦截爬虫，结果换了个浏览器，设置就失效了，还得重新配一遍。这种重复劳动特别烦人，尤其是在不同工具之间来回切换的时候。这篇讲的就是Cloudflare怎么解决这个痛点，让偏好设置能自动同步。它不只是在说一个功能，更像是在讲一个团队如何发现用户真正卡住的地方，然后动手修好。读的时候可以看看他们怎么描述问题，以及为什么这个看似简单的同步，做起来其实没那么容易。

companies.name: Prized
companies.originalOneLiner: Lovable for internal tools
companies.originalDescription: Prized lets non-engineers build, deploy, and share secure internal tools with AI, no engineering required. You don't need to know where the data lives, what APIs to use, or which connectors you need. Just describe what you want (a customer lookup, a dashboard, an approval flow), and Prized builds the tool on top of the right company data inside a governed boundary. The people who feel the pain of missing internal tools most are non-engineers. They understand the workflow best but are blocked by the software layer, so they wait on engineering, duct-tape spreadsheets together, or increasingly rip company data into Claude Code and Cursor with no thought to permissions, sharing, or governance. Prized makes security the default, enforced in the infrastructure rather than left to whoever built the tool. Each tool gets access only to the tables and integrations it was explicitly granted, credentials are workspace-scoped so tools can't cross org boundaries, and outbound calls go through a controlled layer. As an employee builds and shares, a teammate forks it and re-points it at their own data, and over time the company builds up a library of governed tools it actually owns. Hudson was founding engineer at Gander (F24, acquired by Archer), then full-stack at Suno. Marinos studied CS and ME at Stanford and was on the same Gander team.
companies.story: Prized 是一家面向非工程师的软件开发工具公司，让不懂代码的人也能构建、部署和分享安全的内部工具。想象你是一位运营经理，每天靠电子表格和口头催促来管理客户信息，却因为不懂编程而无法快速搭建一个客户查询系统。Prized 让你用自然语言描述需求，比如“做一个客户查询界面”，它就会自动连接公司数据，生成一个合规的工具，并且每个工具都只授予必要的权限，确保安全。这家公司来自 YC 夏季批次，团队虽小，但直击了企业内部工具开发的痛点，让业务人员不再依赖技术团队，值得关注。

companies.name: Inth
companies.originalOneLiner: Enterprise privacy governance for companies that ship fast
companies.originalDescription: Inth helps fast-moving software teams prevent privacy failures before they reach production. Privacy risk no longer lives in policy docs, dashboards, and questionnaires. It lives in code: consent flows, data deletion, vendors, logs, AI systems, and agent-written changes that move user data every day. Inth starts with c15t, an open-source consent and privacy SDK with 3M+ npm downloads, used by teams like Zed, Infisical, and Expo. From there, Inth expands into code-native workflows for consent management, data subject requests, policy enforcement, vendor oversight, and audit-ready evidence. We make privacy governance programmable, observable, and compliant by default.
companies.story: Inth 是一家专注企业隐私合规的开发者工具公司，帮助快速迭代的软件团队在代码层面预防隐私问题。假如你是一位负责隐私合规的工程师，你发现隐私风险不再只存在于政策文档里，而是藏在代码中，比如用户同意流程、数据删除、日志记录等。Inth 提供的开源 SDK 已经被大量下载，它能将隐私治理变成可编程的代码，自动执行同意管理、数据主体请求等合规操作，并生成审计证据。这家公司来自 YC 春季批次，团队三人，却已经获得开发者社区的认可，说明隐私治理正在走向代码原生。

companies.name: Socratix AI
companies.originalOneLiner: AI coworkers for fraud and compliance teams.
companies.originalDescription: Socratix builds AI coworkers for fraud and compliance teams so that humans don't have to spend their days drowning in alerts and spreadsheets. Today, fraud and risk teams at fintechs and banks are overwhelmed. Analysts jump between tools, manually stitch together context, and make judgment calls under pressure, often for hundreds of alerts a week. Too much of their work is slow, repetitive, and error-prone. We're here to change that. Socratix gives fraud and risk teams AI coworkers that investigate alerts in real time, replacing manual reviews with fast, explainable decisions. Socratix agents plug into existing workflows and reason across signals just like human analysts to help teams reduce fraud losses, minimize false positives, and scale operations without scaling headcount. We've seen this problem firsthand. At DoorDash, Riya helped save $30M+ a year by building smarter fraud detection and investigation tooling, and at Unit21, she built products for analysts that made them 3X faster. We're able to build and sell enterprise-grade software. At Cruise, Satya built scalable AI systems powering petabyte-scale data, and at LinkedIn, he built enterprise products from 0 to 1 generating $50M+ in incremental revenue. Now, the two of us are teaming up to eliminate the manual toil in fraud and compliance. We're obsessed with fraud, LLMs, real-world automation, and the messy edge cases traditional ML has trouble handling. We believe that every fraud analyst should have an AI coworker - and the future of fraud will involve combining human-level reasoning with machine-speed execution.
companies.story: Socratix AI 为欺诈和合规团队打造人工智能同事，让分析师从海量警报和电子表格中解脱出来。想象你是一位风控分析师，每周要处理几百个警报，手动拼接信息，在压力下快速判断，既慢又容易出错。Socratix 的智能体可以实时调查警报，像人类分析师一样推理，但速度更快，且决策可解释。它还能接入现有工作流，帮助团队减少欺诈损失和误报。这家公司来自 YC 夏季批次，正在招聘，团队成员曾在大公司帮助节省数千万美元，他们的经验让这个解决方案更具说服力。

companies.name: OS3
companies.originalOneLiner: Full Stack Robotics: US-Built Commercial Robots & Video Action Models
companies.originalDescription: We are building robots, including custom actuators and intelligence. Our first model is trained on 150k hours of video data. Our first commercial robot, a mobile semi-humanoid priced at $9,995, is already signed for deployments in hospitality and biotech. Our developer version helps startups deploy robots in their own industries, and we already have preorders. We are scaling American robotics while making it accessible to more businesses.
companies.story: OS3 是一家全栈机器人公司，在美国制造商用机器人，并开发视频动作模型。想象你是一家酒店的管理者，需要机器人协助搬运物品，但市场上的机器人要么太贵，要么不灵活。OS3 的移动半人形机器人售价不到一万美元，已经签约部署在酒店和生物科技领域。它不只是一个手机应用，而是把智能放进实体设备中，通过摄像头和传感器感知环境，执行物理任务。这家公司来自 YC 夏季批次，已有预订单，正在招聘，显示出美国本土机器人制造的潜力。

companies.name: Synapse Semiconductor
companies.originalOneLiner: New semiconductors that merge compute and vision
companies.originalDescription: We want to push machines to where humans cant go. Presidential early career award winning Duke Semiconductor ECE Faculty Tania Roy and her past student / VC Associate Sanjeev Chauhan are building a frontier semiconductor research lab. Their focus is on solving physical AI challenges from the semiconductor device level and building products around the moat of impossible to copy innovation. Their first work is on a new vision sensor that can run neural network filters right in the camera pixels and only collect data that machines care about. As physical AI develops, machines needs to understand the world around them if they aim to interact with them.
companies.story: Synapse Semiconductor 是一家半导体初创公司，专注于将计算和视觉融合的新型芯片。想象你是一位机器人工程师，你的机器人需要实时理解周围环境，但传统摄像头和处理器功耗高、延迟大。Synapse 的视觉传感器可以在像素级运行神经网络，只收集机器关心的数据，大幅提升效率。这不仅仅是软件优化，而是从硬件层面解决物理人工智能的挑战。公司创始人曾获总统早期职业奖，来自 YC 夏季批次，虽然团队只有两人，但技术壁垒很高，值得关注。

companies.name: Harbor
companies.originalOneLiner: AI-native CRO for clinical trial operations
companies.originalDescription: Harbor is building an AI-native contract research organization (CRO) for clinical trials. We started with an AI-native system of record for clinical trial data (electronic data capture system), grew the software business to seven trials and ~$187k in contracted software revenue over the next twelve months, then expanded into full-service trial execution and signed our first CRO contract worth $1.93M over three years. Clinical trials consume 45% of all new drug and device development spend. While some of that goes to software, sites, and patients, the largest line items are services: project management, monitoring, data management, site coordination, source verification, query resolution, record reconciliation, and analysis. Today, drug and device companies outsource clinical operations to legacy CROs and their massive teams, which is why the CRO market is $82B annually. Harbor delivers the regulated services companies buy from legacy CROs, but built around our AI-native system of record from day one. Our software already automates the core data workflows: study build, data capture, query generation, monitoring, signing, and database lock. Because we own the system of record, we can expand into the surrounding service workflows: site contracting and billing, subject engagement and retention, statistics, reporting, and more. We built Harbor because we lived through the problem. Albert spent four years in clinical trials and regulatory strategy at a medical device startup, taking an unproven wearable from first-in-human trials to FDA authorization. Nate brings the technical depth, having built scalable software at Google and Ramp and served as employee #1 at a previous YC startup.
companies.story: Harbor 是一家人工智能原生的临床研究组织，简称为 CRO，为临床试验提供全流程服务。想象你是一家生物科技公司的临床试验负责人，你被传统 CRO 的庞大团队和缓慢流程拖累，试验数据管理混乱。Harbor 从电子数据采集系统起家，现在扩展到全服务试验执行，并签下了大额合同。它用人工智能自动化项目管理、数据监控等环节，提高效率。这家公司来自 YC 春季批次，团队三人，但已有可观的软件收入和 CRO 合同，说明其模式正在被市场接受。

companies.name: Dawn Industries
companies.originalOneLiner: Automatic Diagnosis & Fix for Industrial Automation Cells
companies.originalDescription: VIM connects to the entire cell: PLCs, robots, CNC machines, sensors. When a cell faults, VIM finds the cause, stages the fix, and the operator approves with one click. When a part drifts, VIM catches it seconds after the cut, inside the machine, and recommends the correction. Recovery drops from 30 minutes to under two, saving more than $15,000 per fault in large factories.
companies.story: Dawn Industries 为工业自动化单元提供自动诊断和修复工具，其产品名为 VIM。想象你是一家工厂的运营主管，生产线突然停机，你需要在三十分钟内找到故障原因，但排查过程漫长且昂贵。VIM 连接整个单元，包括 PLC、机器人、数控机床和传感器，当故障发生时，它迅速定位原因，并给出修复建议，你只需点击确认。这样恢复时间从三十分钟缩短到两分钟，每次故障节省大量成本。这家公司来自 YC 夏季批次，正在招聘，其直接解决工厂痛点的能力值得关注。

companies.name: BioStack Platforms
companies.originalOneLiner: Real world training envs for healthcare AI models
companies.originalDescription: BioStack is building the data engine for healthcare and drug discovery AI. The bottleneck is not models. It is access to high-quality biological data. Clinical and experimental data is fragmented, unstructured, and locked inside hospitals, labs, and CROs, while generating new data is slow and expensive. BioStack fixes this with proprietary clinical and preclinical data pipelines that turn real biomedical workflows into ML-ready training environments. We structure longitudinal multimodal data across imaging, EHR, and experimental assays, then package it for post-training and reinforcement learning so models can learn how research and care actually happen. Instead of static datasets, BioStack gives AI labs workflow-aligned data and environments that improve reasoning, decision-making, and real-world performance in biology and medicine.
companies.story: BioStack Platforms 是医疗人工智能的数据引擎，提供真实的训练环境。想象你是一位药物研发科学家，你想让人工智能模型学习临床和实验数据，但这些数据分散、格式混乱，而且难以获取。BioStack 通过专有的数据管道，将真实生物医学工作流转化为机器学习可用的格式，包括影像、电子病历和实验数据。它不只是提供静态数据集，而是提供与工作流对齐的训练环境，帮助模型提升推理和决策能力。这家公司来自 YC 春季批次，正在招聘，团队四人，其解决数据瓶颈的思路对医疗人工智能至关重要。

companies.name: Clara
companies.originalOneLiner: AI primary care doctor
companies.originalDescription: Clara is an AI primary care and longevity practice from the team that founded and grew Circle Medical to $100M in revenue. Our mission at Clara is to add one billion years of healthspan to humanity. We do this with an AI with deep clinical knowledge, coupled with the ability to sift through medical data to detect trends and patterns that could be missed. Unlike Claude or ChatGPT, Clara can see your medical data and then act. Chat with Clara as you would a doctor and Clara can help with you make sense of symptoms, get medication refills, order and understand labs, and achieve health goals. Medical recommendations are preliminary until one of our human medical providers in the loop reviews and approves them.
companies.story: Clara 是一家提供人工智能初级保健和长寿服务的公司，由曾创立 Circle Medical 的团队打造。想象你是一位关注健康的中年人，你有一些症状但不确定是否严重，预约医生又很麻烦。Clara 可以像医生一样与你对话，分析你的医疗数据，发现潜在趋势，帮助你理解症状、续药、解读化验结果。虽然推荐只是初步建议，但背后有人类医生审核。这家公司来自 YC 春季批次，团队九人，其创始团队有成功经验，目标是为人类增加健康寿命，值得关注。

companies.name: Maywood
companies.originalOneLiner: The first finance-compliant proactive AI that runs 24/7
companies.originalDescription: Maywood is the first finance-compliant proactive AI that runs 24/7, working across your network, pipeline, and active processes, running constantly in the background and surfacing things you'd otherwise miss. It tracks relationships and sector context to flag when a target is gearing up for a process (and drafts the outreach in your voice), watches network activity across LinkedIn, news, and conference follow-ups, and surfaces where active processes stand, including what's at risk since you last looked. It also auto-updates CRMs and trackers and creates meeting briefs that includes relationship history, recent activity, deal context, external research, talking points that can pull from internal and external data sources. Dealmakers interact with it over email, Teams, or the platform itself.
companies.story: Maywood 是一款金融合规的主动式人工智能，全天候运行，帮助交易人员捕捉机会。想象你是一位投资银行家，你负责跟踪潜在收购目标，但信息分散在邮件、新闻和社交网络中，你常常错过关键信号。Maywood 持续监控网络和行业动态，当目标公司准备启动流程时，它会提醒你并起草邮件。它还能更新 CRM 系统，生成会议简报，包含关系历史、交易背景和外部研究。这家公司来自 YC 冬季批次，正在招聘，团队五人，其主动式工作方式可能改变交易人员的日常工作。

readings.title: Get rid of your CAPTCHA, the future of the web is bots
readings.story: 每次在网页上勾选红绿灯、识别斑马线，你是不是也烦过？验证码本意是拦住机器人，结果常常连真人都被卡住。这篇来自 Stack Overflow 的文章提出一个大胆想法：干脆别用验证码了，未来网络本来就是机器人的天下。它适合那些正在为注册流程、垃圾信息发愁的团队，也适合好奇技术风向的人。读的时候，可以留意作者怎么从用户抱怨一路推到产品决策，看他如何权衡安全、体验和成本，而不是只听结论。

readings.title: Why to Start a Startup in a Bad Economy (2008)
readings.story: 经济不好时，大家第一反应是缩紧开支、保住饭碗，很少有人会想这时候去创业。但偏偏有人觉得，这反而是好时机。这篇 2008 年的老文章最近又在技术社区被翻出来，说明今天的很多人正面临同样的困惑：市场冷清，机会到底在哪？文章不是教你怎么融资，而是讲为什么逆境能逼出更务实的想法。读的时候，可以想想作者说的哪些条件今天依然成立，哪些已经变了。

readings.title: The Single English County Saying No to Palantir
readings.story: 当一家科技巨头想进入公共部门，通常都是政府点头、公司签约，很少听到反对的声音。但英国有一个郡偏偏说不，拒绝与 Palantir 合作。这件事听起来像地方新闻，其实牵扯到隐私、权力和公共服务的边界。适合那些关心技术如何落地、以及谁在替普通用户把关的人读。读的时候，可以留意作者如何呈现双方的理由，而不是简单站队。

companies.name: Amorphic Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: Software Commerce Infrastructure for Agents
companies.originalDescription: The next billion software users are AI agents, yet fully autonomous agents remain impossible while every account, bill, and tool still runs through a human. We solve this for both agents and software vendors: vendors use us to let agents sign up and get billed directly, and to improve their agent experience across interfaces like MCP. Agents use us to find, acquire, and pay for what they need, including MCP servers, APIs, datasets, and skills.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是面向智能体的软件商业基础设施。想象你是一家软件公司的销售负责人，过去要花大量时间处理客户的注册、账单和续费，而现在越来越多的客户变成了自动化的智能体，它们不会填表格，也不会打电话。Amorphic Labs 让智能体可以直接注册你的服务并自动付费，同时帮你优化智能体使用你产品时的体验。反过来，智能体也能通过它找到并购买需要的接口、数据集和技能。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队只有两个人，但切中的是智能体经济里最基础的钱和账号问题，值得关注。

companies.name: Unsiloed AI
companies.originalOneLiner: API for parsing multimodal unstructured data
companies.originalDescription: AI teams spend 6+ months building document workflows, yet fewer than 10% ever reach production. Generic LLM parsers and OCR collapse on multimodal documents with text, tables, images, and charts. Poor parsing and suboptimal chunking cripple RAG pipelines and downstream automation. Unsiloed AI has built state-of-the-art vision models which serves as the infrastructure layer for turning unstructured data into structured, queryable, and LLM-ready assets. Our APIs are already parsing hundreds of thousands of documents for startups and NASDAQ-listed enterprises, powering vertical AI solutions across industries. On public benchmarks, Unsiloed AI consistently outperforms solutions from LlamaIndex, Gemini, Mistral, and Unstructured.io among others.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是把多模态非结构化数据变成结构化数据的接口服务。假如你是一家企业的数据工程师，正在搭建一个知识库检索系统，却发现文档里的表格、图片和图表总是被解析得乱七八糟，导致下游应用效果很差。Unsiloed AI 用自研的视觉模型来处理这些复杂文档，把内容变成人工智能可以直接使用的格式。它的接口已经在为初创公司和纳斯达克上市企业解析数十万份文档，公开基准测试里也超过了多个主流方案。来自 YC 秋季 2025 批次，正在招聘，团队虽小但已经进入大企业，值得关注。

companies.name: Adialante
companies.originalOneLiner: Cancer screening without barriers
companies.originalDescription: We know how to improve cancer outcomes by 8x-10x: you catch it early. MRI is the most robust and powerful cancer-detection tool in the world, yet systems cost millions to purchase, take months to install, and require high levels of technical skill to operate. We've redesigned MRI from the ground up with new physics, algorithms, and hardware, all to bring cancer screening to the entire world. Our mobile MRI is an imaging clinic on wheels. No equipment to buy, no infrastructure needed. For a flat per-scan fee, any medical site can offer MRI cancer screening. Starting with prostate cancer. Then everything else.
companies.story: 这家公司想重新发明核磁共振成像设备，让癌症筛查变得没有门槛。想象你是一家基层诊所的负责人，一直想给病人提供核磁检查，但设备要几百万美元，安装还要好几个月，根本负担不起。Adialante 把核磁设备改造成了移动诊所，按次收费，任何医疗点都能直接提供筛查服务，不用买设备，也不用改造场地。它从前列腺癌开始，未来扩展到更多癌症类型。来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队四人，正在招聘。这种把大型医疗设备小型化、服务化的思路，可能真的能改变癌症早筛的普及率。

companies.name: Pocket
companies.originalOneLiner: Take Notes in the Real World
companies.originalDescription: Pocket is a Y Combinator W26 company building a premium hardware plus software product in the AI voice recorder space. We are obsessed with quality and speed. We are scaling very fast in the US and now European markets and building a device experience that can become the category leader.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是人工智能语音记录设备，硬件加软件一起卖。想象你是一个经常开会、采访或者灵光一现的创意工作者，过去掏出手机录音总觉得不方便，而且录完还要花时间整理。Pocket 是一个小巧的随身设备，能随时随地记录语音，并自动转成文字和摘要。它不只是一个手机应用，而是把录音能力放进了专用硬件里，让你不用打开手机就能快速记录。团队十五人，来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，正在招聘，产品在美国和欧洲增长很快，目标是成为这个品类的领导者。

companies.name: Billow AI Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: AI-native Accounting Firm to Replace the Big-4
companies.originalDescription: Billow handles the work of Accounting and FP&A FTEs keeping teams compliant and audit-ready. We work within existing stacks (NetSuite, Coupa, and 80+ other systems) and complex spreadsheets, chasing down information and coordinating approvals across stakeholders. Built by repeat founders; Joan built and exited an accounting/ERP platform (45,000 businesses in 4 years) and Phil built Bloomberg's financial “brain” data infrastructure, and as CTO of a trading platform ($1B in volume). Advisors include CFOs, controllers, auditors from publicly-traded biopharma, and a Big-4 Accounting firm.
companies.story: 这家公司想做一个人工智能原生的会计事务所，替代传统的四大。想象你是一家公司的财务负责人，月底要对账、准备审计材料，还要协调各个部门提供数据，常常忙得焦头烂额。Billow AI Labs 能自动完成会计和财务分析的工作，并且接入你现有的企业管理系统和表格，帮你追着各部门要数据、协调审批。创始人之前做过会计和企业管理系统平台，服务过四万五千家企业，另一位创始人做过彭博的金融数据基础设施。来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，虽然团队目前为零，但背景很强，值得关注。

companies.name: Voquill
companies.originalOneLiner: The agentic OS for medical labs
companies.originalDescription: Voquill is the modern AI-native operating system for medical labs. This software manages the entire workflow of the lab (accessioning, workflow, reporting, coding, compliance, and revenue) and contains modern agentic AI tools to help each step. For example, pathologists can write reports 20% faster through our voice AI coworker. Incumbent lab operating systems are old, don't scale with how modern labs work, and can’t integrate existing AI solutions. As a result, labs are either building their own or paying millions for band-aid solutions and consultants. We're building an agentic platform to manage every aspect of the lab and displace the billions spent on legacy management systems.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是医疗实验室的人工智能原生操作系统。想象你是一家病理科的主任，每天要处理样本接收、报告撰写、编码合规等一堆琐事，还要面对老旧的信息系统，想引入人工智能却接不进去。Voquill 管理实验室的整个流程，并且内置智能体工具，比如病理医生可以用语音助手写报告，速度提升百分之二十。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队三人，正在招聘。实验室信息系统是个巨大又老旧的市场，Voquill 想用人工智能平台取代那些昂贵的补丁方案，值得关注。

companies.name: Uno Wallet
companies.originalOneLiner: The AI mobile wallet that replaces Apple Pay
companies.originalDescription: We are changing the way that people pay... Founded by: Saket Joshi: www.linkedin.com/in/saket-dattatray-joshi/ Mordi Shadpour: www.linkedin.com/in/mordi-shadpour/
companies.story: 这家公司想用人工智能钱包取代 Apple Pay。想象你是一个经常用手机支付的消费者，每次付款都要解锁手机、打开应用，还要担心支付安全。Uno Wallet 是一个智能钱包应用，它利用人工智能来优化支付流程，可能还能根据你的消费习惯提供建议。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队两人，正在招聘。支付领域竞争激烈，但这家公司有两位创始人，具体背景没有公开，不过能进入 YC 说明想法有独到之处。它能不能真的改变支付方式，还要看产品发布后的表现。

companies.name: Prana
companies.originalOneLiner: An AI primary care doctor in your pocket
companies.originalDescription: Prana replaces the reactive, 15-minute annual physical with continuous, proactive care. We connect to your medical records and wearables to watch for "clinical drift," catching subtle declines in health that human doctors miss between visits. Most AI health apps are just chatbots. Prana is a full-stack medical provider. Our AI acts as a always-on physician that watches your data, explains your labs, and manages your prescriptions. Safety & Scale: We automate 90% of the "grunt work" (history taking, logistics, triage) so our human doctors can focus purely on high-leverage decisions. This allows us to offer 24/7 physician care for a fraction of the cost of traditional care. The Team: - Meer Patel (CEO): JHU BME. Deferred Brown Medical School to build Prana because code scales better than appointments. - Vishvam Rawal (CTO): Ex-Quant. Building high-frequency data infrastructure for health signals. - Sanjit Menon (CHO): Graduating MD Candidate. Deep clinical expertise to ensure our models practice good medicine. Traction: Live in beta with early users.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是口袋里的全科医生，用人工智能提供持续的健康管理。想象你是一个有慢性病的患者，每年只体检一次，平时身体有点小变化也不知道要不要去医院。Prana 连接你的医疗记录和可穿戴设备，持续监测你的健康数据，发现细微的异常就提醒你，还能解释化验单、管理处方。它不只是一个聊天机器人，而是一个完整的医疗服务提供者，人工智能负责大部分工作，人类医生只处理关键决策。来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队四人，创始人有生物医学和量化背景。这种模式可能让全天候的医生服务变得负担得起。

companies.name: Nine Fives
companies.originalOneLiner: RF test equipment for next-gen spacecraft, drones, and cellphones
companies.originalDescription: Nine Fives produces modern radio frequency test equipment and solutions to disrupt the $130B test equipment industry. By combining modern electronics, AI ready test automation, and strategic supply chains, we’re equipping our customers to cut their time to market in half.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是下一代航天器、无人机和手机用的射频测试设备。想象你是一个卫星制造商的测试工程师，过去测试一台设备要花几周时间，而且设备又贵又笨重。Nine Fives 用现代电子和人工智能自动化重新设计了测试设备，能帮客户把产品上市时间缩短一半。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队两人，正在招聘。测试设备行业有一千三百亿美元的市场，但创新缓慢，这家公司想用新方法切入，值得关注。

companies.name: OneCLI
companies.originalOneLiner: YC S26) – OSS sandboxed agent harness for teams
companies.originalDescription: YC S26) – OSS sandboxed agent harness for teams
companies.story: 这家公司发布了一个开源的沙盒智能体工具，叫 OneCLI，是 YC 夏季 2026 批次的项目。想象你是一个团队的技术负责人，想让团队成员安全地运行人工智能智能体，但又担心它们访问敏感数据或执行危险操作。OneCLI 提供了一个沙盒环境，让智能体在隔离的空间里运行，既方便协作又安全。它通过 Launch HN 发布，说明是开发者社区关注的项目。虽然团队规模和具体业务没有公开，但开源工具往往能快速积累用户，值得关注。

readings.title: Why is there no programmatic access to the Start menu pin list? (2003)
readings.story: 当你第一次用电脑时，可能会好奇：为什么某些软件能固定在开始菜单，而另一些不能？这个问题看似简单，却困扰了无数开发者。2003年，一位微软工程师在博客上回答了这个问题，如今这篇文章又被翻出来讨论。它不仅仅是一个技术问答，更像是一扇窗，让人看到操作系统设计背后的权衡。读的时候，不妨留意作者如何解释那些看似任性的限制，以及他如何把复杂的系统逻辑讲得通俗易懂。

readings.title: [AINews] Death of Params: Z.ai CEO Jie Tang on GLM 5.3 and the new Post-training Scaling Law
readings.story: 在人工智能领域，模型的参数规模曾是衡量实力的标尺，但最近风向变了。Z.ai的CEO在访谈中提出了“后训练扩展定律”，这可能会让很多人的认知发生动摇。如果你关注人工智能行业的动态，这篇访谈值得一读，因为它不仅解释了技术趋势，还揭示了公司战略的转变。读的时候，可以思考一下：当大家都在追求大模型时，为什么有人开始反其道而行之？这种变化又会给谁带来机会？

readings.title: Waymo’s cheaper, next-gen robotaxi is now open to all riders in these three cities
readings.story: 想象一下，你站在路边，一辆没有司机的车缓缓停下，你扫码上车，它带你穿过城市。这不是科幻，Waymo的新一代机器人出租车已经向三个城市的乘客开放。对普通人来说，这或许只是出行方式的升级，但对整个行业来说，这可能意味着商业模式的成熟。这篇报道分析了它的意义，不妨读读看，它如何把技术进展转化为大众可用的服务，以及这对未来交通有什么影响。

companies.name: Synphony
companies.originalOneLiner: robots & software for farms
companies.originalDescription: Strawberry farming is a $3B industry in California alone with 60% labor cost using 40-year old software. Synphony provides strawberry picking robots and software services including: bed-level analytics, data pipeline integration, and agentic solutions. Synphony's "side hustle" is selling data, evals, and viral demos to robot foundation labs while building capacity for general robot deployments. We've started with strawberry farming for great margins and outdoor data moat, but also received requests for robots in semi-conductors and autonomous space labs. Synphony's team has won over 15 hackathons together (taking home 4 Jensen-signed GPUs!). Sean did ML research at NVIDIA and led AI products used by IRS and Citibank. Lucas' research spanned robotics, IoT devices, and neuromorphic computing. Alex architected an app with 400k users.
companies.story: Synphony 是一家把机器人和软件带入农业的公司，从草莓采摘切入。想象你是一个大型草莓农场的运营负责人，每天最头疼的就是人力成本太高，占掉六成开销，而地里用的软件还是四十年前的老古董。Synphony 的采摘机器人能下地干活，同时提供地块级别的数据分析、数据管道整合和智能体方案，让你对每块地的收成和成本一目了然。更妙的是，他们顺带把农业数据卖给机器人基础模型实验室，还收到了半导体和太空实验室的机器人需求。团队拿过十五次黑客松大奖，成员有 NVIDIA 研究背景和做过 IRS 与花旗银行人工智能产品的经历，值得关注。

companies.name: Traceforce
companies.originalOneLiner: Securing AI native apps directly on devices
companies.originalDescription: AI apps such as ChatGPT and Claude have become part of everyone's daily workflow, but they introduce new security risks that traditional security tools weren't built to handle. Security teams at companies from startups to Fortune 500s, are struggling to keep up. Traceforce gives a company’s security team visibility of how AI apps are being used across company’s devices, and the ability to detect and prevent security breaches and unsafe actions as early as possible.
companies.story: Traceforce 做的是保护人工智能应用安全的工具，切的是企业安全这个方向。假如你是一家公司的安全主管，员工天天用 ChatGPT 和 Claude 干活，可传统安全工具根本看不见这些应用里发生了什么，数据泄露风险让你睡不着觉。Traceforce 能让你在公司所有设备上看到人工智能应用的使用情况，及时发现和阻止不安全的行为。它来自 YC 夏季批次，团队虽然只有两个人但正在招人，说明他们已经有客户在用了，这个方向对从初创到大厂的安全团队都很有吸引力。

companies.name: Perspectives Health
companies.originalOneLiner: AI to run behavioral health programs better
companies.originalDescription: America is facing an addiction and mental health crisis, but the treatment programs trying to solve the problem are faced with administrative burden, staff shortages, and pressure from payers. We work with treatment programs to incorporate AI that reduces administrative burden, prevents insurance denials, and helps directors run their program better. Our agents analyze charts to prevent insurance denials, complete documentation and insurance paperwork to save staff time, and sift through historical data to find opportunities for improvement.
companies.story: Perspectives Health 用人工智能帮助行为健康治疗项目更好地运转，瞄准的是美国成瘾和心理健康危机背后的管理难题。想象你是一家戒毒治疗项目的主任，每天被文书和保险理赔压得喘不过气，还要应付员工短缺和支付方的压力。这个平台能自动分析病历防止保险拒赔，帮忙填写文书和保险文件，还能从历史数据里找改进机会，让你的团队从行政泥潭里脱身。它来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队五个人正在招人，说明已经有治疗项目在用，值得关注。

companies.name: Lightsprint
companies.originalOneLiner: Collaborative product development with cloud agents
companies.originalDescription: Lightsprint is a collaborative platform for software teams to plan visually, preview live and ship with an army of cloud agents. Your whole team, including non-engineers, can now ship end to end reliably. The company is founded by Ben Ong, an AI investor who previously scaled AI products at SEA Group (NYSE: SE) and Temasek ($300B fund), Benedict Chan who was VP Engineering at Chainlink and CTO at BitGo (NYSE:BTGO), and Heng Hong Lee who built Facebook Messenger in 2013 and was Director of Engineering at Fazz (YC S17).
companies.story: Lightsprint 是一个让软件团队协作开发产品的云平台，核心是让非工程师也能参与交付。想象你是一个产品经理，每天要和技术团队来回对齐需求，还要盯着开发进度，但代码仓库对你来说就像黑盒。在 Lightsprint 上，你们可以可视化地规划、实时预览，然后让一群云端智能体帮你把功能真正发出去，整个团队包括非工程师都能端到端地交付。创始人背景很亮眼，有做过 Facebook Messenger 的工程总监，还有 Chainlink 的工程副总裁，来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，正在招人。

companies.name: Operon
companies.originalOneLiner: Agentic data layer for manufacturing & process industries.
companies.originalDescription: Operon is the data intelligence layer for heavy industry. We ingest the messy documents a plant runs on (P&IDs, schematics, datasheets, scans) and turn them into one structured, queryable model of the facility. On top of it, engineers query their plant in natural language and build agentic workflows for safety, compliance, and design.
companies.story: Operon 做的是重工业的数据智能层，把工厂里那些杂乱无章的文档变成可查询的结构化模型。想象你是一个化工厂的工程负责人，手里一堆管道仪表图、设备数据表和扫描件，想查个参数得翻半天档案，更别提做安全合规分析了。Operon 把这些文档吃进去，整理成一个统一的设施模型，你就能用自然语言直接问问题，还能构建安全、合规和设计方面的智能体工作流。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，目前正在招人，团队规模虽小但方向很实在。

companies.name: Replicas
companies.originalOneLiner: Run any coding agent harness in the cloud
companies.originalDescription: Replicas is a background coding agent that allows you to delegate tasks to Claude Code or Codex from Slack, Linear, GitHub, and more. Each task works inside of a sandboxed virtual machine, allowing teams to heavily parallelize work and burn through tickets. Replicas agents output higher quality PRs via feedback loops - each task automatically is notified and fixes CI failures and reads all code reviews. With Environments, engineering teams can configure agents to run their entire codebase locally, verify its work, and provide preview URLs.
companies.story: Replicas 是一个云端编码智能体平台，让你能同时跑很多个编码任务。想象你是一个研发团队的负责人，平时用 Slack、Linear 和 GitHub 协调工作，但代码评审和修 CI 故障特别耗时。Replicas 能让你从这些工具里直接派任务给 Claude Code 或 Codex，每个任务在独立的虚拟机里跑，还能自动处理 CI 失败和代码评审意见，生成高质量的合并请求。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队两人正在招人，这种把编码智能体并行化的思路很值得关注。

companies.name: Aseon Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: Robotic pitstops for self-driving cars
companies.originalDescription: Aseon Labs builds robotic pitstops for self-driving cars. Autonomous vehicles can drive themselves, but they still rely on humans and centralized depots for charging, cleaning and servicing multiple times per day. As fleets scale, the operational layer makes up 70% of the cost of the service and is of the largest barrier to uptime, profitability and market expansion. Aseon Pods are robotic micro-depots that can be deployed directly within operating zones, bringing fleet servicing to where demand exists. By eliminating unnecessary depot trips and automating routine operations, Aseon helps autonomous fleet operators increase uptime, reduce reset cost by 50% and unlock scale. Founded by the team behind Pushme, which deployed 5,000 mobility infrastructure locations across 40 cities before its acquisition by TIER-Dott, Aseon is funded and building product in Redwood City for pilot deployment with major autonomous vehicle operators.
